compute_all_horizontal: compute logical AND horizontally across columns using pl.all_horizontal with Kleene null handling
compute_any_horizontal: compute logical OR horizontally across columns using pl.any_horizontal with Kleene null handling
compute_max_min_horizontal: compute maximum and minimum values horizontally across columns using pl.max_horizontal and pl.min_horizontal
compute_sum_mean_horizontal: compute sum and mean of values horizontally across columns using pl.sum_horizontal and pl.mean_horizontal with ignore_nulls
compute_cum_sum_horizontal: compute cumulative sum of values horizontally across columns using pl.cum_sum_horizontal
